gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 战争烽火下的中国味道与人性挣扎，罕见的中东中餐馆题材，年度惊喜。
gems.whyWatchEn: War, kitchen, and humanity collide in a rare story about a Chinese restaurant in the Middle East—an unexpected gem.
gems.audience: 喜欢战争史诗与平民视角的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy war epics and ordinary people's perspectives.

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 假孕骗局背后是女性被社会期待压垮的惊心真相，纪录片真实得令人屏息。
gems.whyWatchEn: A shocking documentary about a fake pregnancy driven by crushing social expectations—raw, unsettling, and vital.
gems.audience: 关注社会现实与非虚构叙事的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in social realities and non-fiction storytelling.

gems.title: 维什瓦纳特父子
gems.summary: 桑贾伊·维什瓦纳特是一位备受赞誉的专业手枪射击运动员，年过四十，在名利场上可谓功成名就。然而，当他与二十多岁的女孩玛迪相遇后，两人之间因较大的年龄差距产生了种种碰撞与问题，迫使他们不得不重新审视并坦然面对。
gems.summaryEn: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that th
gems.whyWatch: 金牌射手与年轻女孩的忘年恋，打破年龄与偏见，细腻又充满力量。
gems.whyWatchEn: An age-gap bond between a celebrated marksman and a young woman, told with tenderness and cultural nuance.
gems.audience: 喜欢情感细腻、关注非传统关系的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of nuanced emotional drama and unconventional relationships.

gems.title: 末世行者
gems.summary: 一场大流行病席卷全球后，人口锐减。在科罗拉多州的飞机库里，一名男子与他的狗和一位阴郁的枪手相伴过着孤寂的生活。当他驾驶着老旧的塞斯纳飞机时，无线电里突然传来神秘的信号，由此引发了一场追寻声音来源的探索之旅。
gems.summaryEn: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmis
gems.whyWatch: 末日废土上人与狗寻着无线电信号出发，孤寂浪漫的独立科幻小品。
gems.whyWatchEn: A lonely man, his dog, and a mysterious radio signal—a contemplative sci-fi road movie with quiet heart.
gems.audience: 喜欢低概念、人物驱动的科幻片观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of low-concept, character-driven science fiction.

gems.title: 斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙
gems.titleEn: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
gems.summary: 故事聚焦《大爆炸》的漫画书老板斯图尔特·布鲁姆，他弄坏了一个谢尔顿和莱纳德制造的设备，意外导致了多元宇宙的世界末日，他必须与女友Denise、地质学家Bert和量子物理学家Barry一起去将现实复原。一路上，他们遇到了平行宇宙版本的各个《大爆炸》角色，事情进展并不顺利。
gems.summaryEn: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.
gems.whyWatch: 《生活大爆炸》宇宙爆笑衍生，书店老板意外搞垮多元宇宙，脑洞与情怀齐飞。
gems.whyWatchEn: A hilarious Big Bang spinoff where comic-book shop owner Stuart breaks reality—pure fan-service comedy with a multiversal twist.
gems.audience: 《生活大爆炸》粉丝和喜欢无厘头科幻喜剧的观众
gems.audienceEn: Big Bang fans and lovers of absurd sci-fi comedy.

gems.title: 重器
gems.summary: 以改革开放初期至1997年《刑诉法》《刑法》修订为背景，讲述陈一众、余高远、张丽慧、夏英杰等法学院毕业生在不同司法岗位上历经风雨、共同见证中国法治发展进程的故事，展现他们在时代浪潮中成长、抉择与命运交织的群像篇章。
gems.summaryEn: In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.
gems.whyWatch: 法学院毕业生的司法人生，见证中国法治进程，主旋律剧难得有不说教的厚重质感。
gems.whyWatchEn: A sweeping legal drama following law graduates through China's judicial transformation—serious, human, and quietly compelling.
gems.audience: 喜欢历史年代剧和职业成长叙事的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy historical period pieces and career-growth narratives.

gems.title: 绿灯军团
gems.summary: 跟随约翰·斯图尔特与绿灯军团传奇哈尔·乔丹的脚步，看这两位星际警察如何深入美国腹地，调查一起谋杀命案。
gems.summaryEn: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.
gems.whyWatch: 两位绿灯侠深入美国腹地查案，DC罕见地拍出了太空警察的乡土悬疑感。
gems.whyWatchEn: Green Lanterns John Stewart and Hal Jordan investigate a murder in the American heartland—an unusual, grounded DC mystery.
gems.audience: DC粉丝和喜欢超级英雄+探案混合类型的观众
gems.audienceEn: DC fans and viewers who enjoy superhero-meets-detective stories.

gems.title: 仙逆
gems.summary: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。
gems.summaryEn: It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid
gems.whyWatch: 凡人少年逆天修仙，国产动画以沉稳叙事和绝美打斗证明修仙题材的深度可能。
gems.whyWatchEn: A humble boy defies fate in this Chinese donghua that combines stunning action with unexpectedly deep cultivation drama.
gems.audience: 喜欢修仙玄幻和国漫精品的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of cultivation fantasy and top-tier Chinese animation.
